ArticleChapo.title: Article Chapô
ArticleChapo.description: Centered article intro — eyebrow, title, lead paragraph, author and date

title.title: Article title (optional — if omitted uses HeroBanner title)

BannerCarousel.title: Banner Carousel
BannerCarousel.description: Rotating promotional banners for the homepage

CategoryTiles.title: Category Tiles (use 3, 6 or 9 tiles)
CategoryTiles.description: Editorial tile grid — 3 tiles per row. ⚠️ Always add 3, 6 or 9 tiles for clean rows. Each tile: image + tag + title, fully clickable.

tiles.title: Tiles (add 3, 6 or 9)
tiles.description: ⚠️ Always add a multiple of 3 (3, 6 or 9) — the grid displays 3 tiles per row.

image.title: Image
image.description: Pick from media library or paste an external URL

imageUrl.title: Or external image URL
imageUrl.description: Alternative — paste a full https:// URL if you do not want to use the media library

tag.title: Tag (small red label, optional)
tag.description: Short uppercase label shown above the title (e.g. MEMBERSHIP, FANS)

textAlign.title: Text alignment
textAlign.description: left / center / right — where the tag and title are positioned inside the tile

CountdownBanner.title: Countdown Banner
CountdownBanner.description: Full-width promotional bar with live countdown timer — disappears when expired

FullWidthShelf.title: Full Width Shelf
FullWidthShelf.description: Full-width product carousel fetched from VTEX catalog by category ID

categorySlug.title: Category Name
categorySlug.description: Exact category name from VTEX Admin (e.g. Soccer, Basketball, Training) — case-insensitive

HeroBanner.title: Hero Banner
HeroBanner.description: Full-width hero with image, title, subtitle and CTA

InkAndTonerFinder.title: Ink & Toner Finder
InkAndTonerFinder.description: Helps shoppers find ink and toner by printer brand, product line, model, or free-text search.

searchPlaceholder.title: Search placeholder
searchPlaceholder.default: Enter the printer model. Ex.: M455dn, C230

footerText.title: Footer text
footerText.default: If you can't find what you're looking for, please contact

manufacturerFacetKey.title: Manufacturer facet key
manufacturerFacetKey.description: Optional VTEX search facet key for the selected manufacturer.

productLineFacetKey.title: Product line facet key
productLineFacetKey.description: Optional VTEX search facet key for the selected product line.

modelFacetKey.title: Model facet key
modelFacetKey.description: Optional VTEX search facet key for the selected model.

manufacturers.title: Manufacturers
manufacturers.description: Leave empty to use the default manufacturer list.

InstagramFeed.title: Instagram Feed
InstagramFeed.description: GET INSPIRED section — editorial image grid with Instagram links

LookbookGrid.title: Lookbook Grid
LookbookGrid.description: 3 editorial cells side by side — image, title, subtitle and CTA link per cell

MegaMenu.title: Mega Menu
MegaMenu.description: Category mega menu fed by catalog categories. Select which departments to show and optionally add custom links.

includeUnlistedDepartments.title: Also show departments not listed below

items.title: Menu items
items.description: Leave empty to show all root categories from the catalog. Use categorySlug to pull a live category (and its subcategories). Use label + url for custom entries.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional. For categories, defaults to the catalog name.

categorySlug.title: Category slug
categorySlug.description: Catalog slug, e.g. office or office/paper. Pulls that category and its children.

url.title: Custom URL
url.description: Used when this item is not a catalog category (or as fallback).

children.title: Custom children
children.description: Additional manual child links (appended after catalog subcategories).

PullQuote.title: Pull Quote
PullQuote.description: Large editorial pull quote with optional attribution. Backgrounds: white, navy, red, gold

RelatedArticles.title: Related Articles
RelatedArticles.description: 3 editorial article cards with image, tag, and title

RichTextBlock.title: Rich Text Block
RichTextBlock.description: Editorial text with optional subtitle per section. Body uses the native Content Platform rich text editor.

SizeGuide.title: Size Guide
SizeGuide.description: Size guide modal injected on the product page — configure the size chart rows

Spacer.title: Spacer
Spacer.description: Full-width vertical spacer with configurable height and background color

height.title: Height (pixels)
height.description: Vertical height of the spacer in pixels (e.g. 40, 80, 120)

StatsBlock.title: Stats Block
StatsBlock.description: 3–4 key statistics displayed in large numbers — ideal for brand content pages

VideoBlock.title: Video Block
VideoBlock.description: Embed a YouTube video or an MP4 file. Pick a video from VTEX Media or paste an external URL.

videoUrl.title: Video (from VTEX Media)
videoUrl.description: Pick a video from the media library. Videos in VTEX are referenced by URL (typically YouTube).

videoUrlExternal.title: Or external video URL
videoUrlExternal.description: Alternative — paste a YouTube URL (youtube.com/watch?v=... or youtu.be/...) or a direct .mp4/.webm/.mov file URL

posterImage.title: Poster image (optional)
posterImage.description: Preview image shown before the video plays. Click triggers playback.

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.description: Auto-start playback (videos will be muted, browser policy)

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: Replay automatically when the video ends

fullWidth.title: Full-width (edge to edge)
fullWidth.description: If enabled, the video spans the entire screen width with no padding

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.default: You entered an invalid Postal Code

noProductsAvailableErrorMessage.title: Error message for the scenario of no products available for a given location
noProductsAvailableErrorMessage.default: There are no products available for %s.
noProductsAvailableErrorMessage.description: The '%s' will be replaced by the postal code value.

buttonActionText.title: Action label to apply the postal code

errorMessageHelper.title: Error message helper
errorMessageHelper.default: Try using a different postal code.
errorMessageHelper.description: This message will guide user in case of an error.

idkPostalCodeLink.title: I don't know my postal code link

text.title: Link Text
text.default: I don't know my Postal Code

description.title: Description
description.default: Offers and availability vary by location.

enabled.title: Display pickup all filter
enabled.description: Display the pickup all filter in the PLP/Search page. This is recommended only for B2B stores.

globalChangePickupPoint.title: Change Global Pickup Point location title

pickupPointChangeApplyButtonLabel.title: Change Pickup Point apply button label

pickupPointClearFilterButtonLabel.title: Clear Pickup Point filter button label

noPickupPointsAvailableInLocation.title: No Pickup Point available near location message

enabled.title: Should enable global filter by pickup point?

deliveryPromiseBadges.title: Delivery Promise badges
deliveryPromiseBadges.description: The badges will be displayed in product cards indicating the delivery methods availability for the product.

enabled.title: Should display In Stock filter?
enabled.description: Allow shoppers to filter only products that are currently in stock. Note: When enabling, ensure that the `hideUnavailableItems` property is set to `false` in the store's `discovery.config.js` file.

minPriceErrorMessage.title: Error message for the minimum price input field
minPriceErrorMessage.default: Min price can't be greater than max

maxPriceErrorMessage.title: Error message for the maximum price input field
maxPriceErrorMessage.default: Max price can't be smaller than min

title.title: Default page title
title.description: Display this title when no other tile is available

titleTemplate.title: Default page title template
titleTemplate.description: Template applied to the page title. Use %s to reference the page title.

publisherId.title: Publisher ID
publisherId.description: A unique identifier used to reference the publisher. This can be a descriptive value (e.g., `#organization`) or a full URL (e.g., `https://example.com/publisher`).

id.title: Organization ID
id.description: A unique reference for the organization. This can be a descriptive value (e.g., #organization) or a full URL (e.g.,https://example.com/organization).

sameAs.title: Organization URLs
sameAs.description: The URL of a page on another website with additional information about your organization. For example, a URL to your organization's profile page on a social media or review site.

logo.title: Organization logo URL
logo.description: A logo that is representative of your organization. Image guidelines: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/organization

image.title: Organization image/logo object
image.description: An image that is representative of your organization. Image guidelines: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/organization

url.title: Organization image URL
url.description: The URL of the image. Make sure the url is crawlable and indexable.

caption.title: Organization image caption
caption.description: A short description of the image.

id.title: Organization image ID
id.description: A unique reference for the image. This can be a descriptive value (e.g., #logo) or a full URL (e.g.,https://example.com/logo).

email.title: Organization email
email.description: The email address to contact your business

telephone.title: Organization phone
telephone.description: A business phone number. Be sure to include the country code and area code in the phone number.

address.title: Organization address
address.description: The address (physical or mailing) of your organization, if applicable.

streetAddress.title: Street Address
streetAddress.description: The full street address of your postal address.

addressLocality.title: City
addressLocality.description: The city of your postal address.

addressCountry.title: Country
addressCountry.description: The country of your postal address. Recommended to be in 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, for example 'BR','US'.

postalCode.title: Postal Code
postalCode.description: The postal code of your postal address.

siteMap.title: Public
siteMap.description: When enabled, this page's URL is added to sitemap.xml so search engines can discover and index it. Disable to keep the page out of the sitemap (e.g. for private, temporary, or campaign-only landing pages).

title.title: Default page title
title.description: Display this title when no other tile is available.

titleTemplate.title: Default page title template
titleTemplate.description: Template applied to the page title. Use %s to reference the page title.

value.title: PDP template value (e.g. Slug: /apple-magic-mouse/p OR /department/category/subcategory/)
value.description: Possible values: the PDP slug template (e.g. '/apple-magic-mouse/p'); A PLP template (e.g. '/department/' OR '/department/category/' OR '/department/category/subcategory/'). If empty, this template will be the generic PDP.

titleTemplate.title: PDP page title template
titleTemplate.description: Template applied to the page title. Use %s to reference the page title.

id.title: ID
id.description: A unique identifier used to reference the product page. This is a descriptive value (e.g., `#product`) that will be concatenated with the product path (example of the result: `/product-slug/p#product`).

mainEntityOfPage.title: Main entity of page
mainEntityOfPage.description: Indicates the main entity of the page. A unique identifier used to reference the product page. This is a descriptive value (e.g., `#webpage`) that will be concatenated with the product path (example of the result: `/product-slug/p#webpage`).

titleTemplate.title: PLP page title template
titleTemplate.description: Template applied to the page title. Use %s to reference the page title.

value.title: PLP template value (e.g. Slug: /department/category/subcategory)
value.description: PLP slug template (e.g. /office or /office/chairs) representing the /department/category/subcategory template). If this field is left empty, the generic PLP template will be applied.

titleTemplate.title: Default page title template
titleTemplate.description: Template applied to the page title. Use %s to reference the page title.
